e.summary: 芬兰金融监管机构：设有 Statistics 统计栏目、报告（Reporting）与登记册（Registers），并覆盖保险消费者与保险中介议题
e.summary_en: Finland’s financial supervisor: a Statistics section, reporting and registers, covering insurance consumers and intermediaries
e.summary_hk: 芬蘭金融監管機構：設有 Statistics 統計欄目、報告（Reporting）與登記冊（Registers），並覆蓋保險消費者與保險中介議題
e.body:
**Finanssivalvonta（芬兰金融监管局，FIN-FSA）** 是**芬兰的金融监管机构**，监管**银行、保险公司与养老金机构**。本条目属本轮**填补北欧空白**——池内**芬兰相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：英文首页 **217.3KB**；⭐ **统计栏目 `/en/statistics/`（174.3KB，实测标题「Statistics - www.finanssivalvonta.fi」）**；站点顶层导航实测含 **Publications and press releases／Forms／Statistics／Regulation／Reporting／Registers／Contact information**，并另设 **Financial market participants**（按行业分类，含 Banks 等）、**Consumers → Insurances** 分支（实测含**保险中介**、**保险理赔**、**保险种类**、**保险合同终止**）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上芬兰**——北欧四国此前在池内均为 0；对做**北欧监管与保险市场比较**的学生，这是继瑞典（本轮 [[pensionsmyndigheten]]、[[finansinspektionen]]）之后的第二块拼图。**② 该站的结构本身有参考价值**——把 **Statistics／Reporting／Registers／Regulation** 拆成顶层栏目，意味着**「统计数据、报送要求、登记册、法规」四件事被明确分开**，这与池内其他监管站点（[[fsca]] 的研究与数据、[[dnb]] 的统计、[[apra-insurance-statistics]] 的行业统计）形成**监管信息架构的比较样本**；其中 **Registers（登记册）** 与 [[pensions-authority-ie]] 的公开登记册同类。**③ 保险消费者侧**（理赔、中介、合同终止）反映**北欧监管对消费者保护口径的重视**，可与 [[hk-icb]]、[[fca-open-data]] 一类消费者保护条目对照。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、统计栏目页与顶层导航结构**，**但未打开任何统计数据集**，因此**不能确认其保险统计的具体口径、频率与覆盖**；**② 站点的英文覆盖度未逐项核实**（芬兰语/瑞典语版本为原版）；**③** 登记册与报送要求**可能需要账号或另设门户**，本次未核实；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供精算工具。**核实说明**：首页（217.3KB）与 `/en/statistics/`（174.3KB）HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与导航；**未打开任何统计数据集**。
e.body_en:
**Finanssivalvonta (FIN-FSA)** is **Finland’s financial supervisory authority**, supervising **banks, insurers and pension institutions**. This entry belongs to this round’s **Nordic gap-filling** — the corpus held **zero Finland-related entries**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the English homepage is **217.3KB**; ⭐ the **statistics section `/en/statistics/` (174.3KB, measured title "Statistics - www.finanssivalvonta.fi")**; the top-level navigation shows **Publications and press releases / Forms / Statistics / Regulation / Reporting / Registers / Contact information**, plus **Financial market participants** (by sector, e.g. Banks) and a **Consumers → Insurances** branch (measured to include **insurance intermediaries**, **insurance claims**, **types of insurance** and **termination of an insurance contract**).

For RIAA: **① it adds Finland** — all four Nordic countries were at zero in the corpus; for students comparing **Nordic supervision and insurance markets**, this is the second piece after Sweden (this round’s [[pensionsmyndigheten]] and [[finansinspektionen]]). **② The site’s structure is itself instructive** — splitting **Statistics / Reporting / Registers / Regulation** into top-level sections means **"statistics, reporting requirements, registers and regulation" are kept clearly separate**, giving a **comparative sample of supervisory information architecture** against other regulator sites in the corpus ([[fsca]] research and data, [[dnb]] statistics, [[apra-insurance-statistics]] industry statistics), while **Registers** is kin to the public register of [[pensions-authority-ie]]. **③ The consumer side** (claims, intermediaries, contract termination) reflects **the Nordic emphasis on consumer protection**, comparable to [[hk-icb]] and [[fca-open-data]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage, the statistics section and the top-level navigation structure**, **but opened no statistical dataset**, so **the specific definitions, frequency and coverage of its insurance statistics cannot be confirmed**; **② English coverage was not verified item by item** (Finnish and Swedish are the original versions); **③** registers and reporting requirements **may require an account or a separate portal, which was not verified**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers actuarial tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage (217.3KB) and `/en/statistics/` (174.3KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and navigation read; **no statistical dataset was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**Finanssivalvonta（芬蘭金融監管局，FIN-FSA）** 是**芬蘭的金融監管機構**，監管**銀行、保險公司與養老金機構**。本條目屬本輪**填補北歐空白**——池內**芬蘭相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：英文首頁 **217.3KB**；⭐ **統計欄目（174.3KB，標題「Statistics - www.finanssivalvonta.fi」）**；頂層導航實測含 **Publications／Forms／Statistics／Regulation／Reporting／Registers／Contact**，並設 **Financial market participants** 與 **Consumers → Insurances**（含**保險中介**、**保險理賠**、**保險種類**、**合同終止**）。

對 RIAA：**① 補上芬蘭**（北歐四國此前均為 0）；**② 該站結構本身有參考價值**——把 **Statistics／Reporting／Registers／Regulation** 拆成頂層欄目，**「統計、報送、登記冊、法規」四件事被明確分開**，與 [[fsca]]、[[dnb]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]] 形成**監管信息架構的比較樣本**；**Registers** 與 [[pensions-authority-ie]] 同類；**③ 保險消費者側**可與 [[hk-icb]]、[[fca-open-data]] 對照。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁、統計欄目與導航結構**，**但未打開任何統計數據集**；**② 英文覆蓋度未逐項核實**；**③** 登記冊與報送**可能需帳號或另設門戶，未核實**；**④** 本詞條**不主張**該站提供精算工具。**核實說明**：兩頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開任何統計數據集**。
